homepage.reader.favoriteDesc: यूनिभर्स ज्ञानको संग्रहालय र लेखकको ब्लगहरू मात्रै केही सुविधाहरू हुन् जुनले तपाईंलाई आफ्नो पसन्दीदा कथाहरू, त्यसका सेटिङहरू र त्यसका निर्माताहरूको बारेमा जान्न मद्दत गर्नेछ!
homepage.reader.communityDesc: विश्वभरिका मानिसहरूसँग समर्पित ब्रह्माण्ड र लेखकका फोरम, ब्लग र अन्य सामुदायिक सुविधाहरूमा भेट्नुहोस्, जहाँ समान विचारधाराका प्रशंसकहरू जम्मा हुन्छन्। सबै एकै ठाउँमा।
homepage.reader.readingFeatureTitle: एक गहिरो तर व्यावहारिक पठन अनुभवको आनन्द लिनुहोस्।
homepage.reader.readingFeatureDesc: कथाहरू र ब्रह्माण्डबाट पृष्ठहरूबीच स्विच नगरीकनै विवरणहरूमा पहुँच पाउँदै सहज पढाइको फाइदा लिनुहोस्।

homepage.writer.title: आफ्नो ब्रह्माण्ड प्रदर्शन गर्नुहोस् र आफ्ना कथाहरू साझा गर्नुहोस्
homepage.writer.writingDesc: लिटरेरी युनिभर्स वर्कशपसँग लेखनको नयाँ तरिका अनुभव गर्नुहोस्।  आफ्नो ब्रह्माण्डका सबै विवरणहरू एक विश्वकोशमा सिर्जना गर्नुहोस्, ती आफ्ना पाठकहरूसँग साझा गर्नुहोस् र त्यस आधारमा अद्भुत कथाहरू लेख्नुहोस्।
homepage.writer.collaborationDesc: Creative process often involves multiple people. No worries, we got you covered! You can easily add beta readers, co-authors and translators to your stories and universes.
homepage.writer.communityDesc: लेखनभन्दा पर जानुहोस् र तपाईंको ब्रह्माण्ड वा लेखकको रूपमा तपाईंसँग सम्बन्धित ब्लग, फोरम र अन्य सामुदायिक सुविधाहरू मार्फत आफ्ना पाठकहरूसँग जडान हुनुहोस्।
homepage.writer.workshopFeatureTitle: तपाईंका सबै सिर्जनात्मक आवश्यकताहरूको लागि एकै ठाउँ
homepage.writer.workshopFeatureDesc: हाम्रो निरन्तर विकसित हुँदै गरेको कार्यशाला तपाईंको सिर्जनात्मक आवश्यकताहरूको लागि मुख्य स्थान हो। एक साधारण विचारबाट अद्भुत ब्रह्माण्डहरू, कथाहरू र त्यससँग सम्बन्धित सबै कुरा सिर्जना गर्नुहोस्।
homepage.writer.monetizationDesc: हामी दृढ विश्वास गर्छौं कि मानिसहरूले आफ्नो कामको लागि पारिश्रमिक पाउनुपर्छ र लेखकहरूका लागि नयाँ मुद्रीकरण अवसरहरू निरन्तर खोजिरहेका छौं। मुद्रीकरण सुविधाले लेखकहरूलाई उनीहरूले गरेको कामको लागि कदरित हुन मद्दत गर्छ। आफ्ना प्रशंसकहरूले तपाईंलाई कदर देखाउन सक्ने सबै विकल्पहरू अन्वेषण गर्नुहोस्।
about.title: साहित्यिक ब्रह्माण्डको बारेमा
about.desc: साहित्यिक ब्रह्माण्ड पछाडिको इतिहास, रहस्य र मानिसहरू।
about.text.1: कला साहित्यिक सृजना र उत्कृष्ट पाठकहरूसाझा गर्न लाग्छ। लेखकहरूले प्लेटफर्म प्रयोग गरेर आफ्नो मूल कृतिहरू सिर्जना गर्न सक्छन्, ड्यासबोर्ड मेनुमा "कार्यशाला" बटन छान्नुहोस्। यसले मुख्य सम्पादक र विज्ञानकोष फंक्सनहरूलाई पहुँच प्रदान गर्दछ, जुन सात्क्षेत्रमा तपाईंको व्यक्तिगत कथाको ब्राह्मिक बिश्लेषणमा ध्यान केन्द्रित भएको छ। सामाजिक सुविधाहरूले लेखकलाई उनीहरूको काम साझा गर्न, एक अनुयाय बनाउन र उनीहरूको पाठकहरूसँग ध्यानसम्पन्न रूपमा अवधारणा गर्न अनुमति दिन्छ।
about.text.2: पाठकहरूले मुख्यतः नयाँ कृतिहरू खोज्न र आफ्ना प्रिय लेखकहरूलाई अनुसर्न सक्छन्, तर लेखकद्वारा अनुमति प्राप्त भएमा तिनीहरूले पूर्व-प्रकाशित कथाहरूमा सम्पादन गर्न पनि सहयोग गर्न सक्छन्। Literary Universe मा पाठक भएर पनि नयाँ पढ्ने अनुभव महत्वपूर्ण छ - मुख्य कथाबाट सम्पूर्ण पृष्ठमा उपस्थित सबै पृष्ठभूमि जानकारीलाई पढ्ने सुविधा लै हाम्रो लेखकको बिचमा बोध प्रदान गर्दछ।
about.text.3: Literary Universe को भविष्यमा लेखकहरूले आफ्ना काम बेच्न सक्ने एक बजार सिर्जना गर्ने र आफ्ना साहित्यमा संचार बढाउने समुदाय सुविधाहरू जोड्ने योजना समावेश गर्छ। हामी समयमा थप लेखकका उपकरणहरू पेश गर्ने योजना गरेका छौं, जुनमा वर्तमानमा विकास वा योजनाबद्ध दशकभन्दा बढी हुन्छन्। हाम्रो अग्रणी लक्ष्य हो लेखकहरू र पाठकहरूको अनुभवलाई अभिव्यक्ति माध्यम सहयोगमा आधारित गरी इन्टरनेट स्रोत संघटित गर्न।
about.text.4: हामी आशा गर्छौं कि तपाईं हामीसँग सामेल हुनुहुनेछ र अन्तर्जाल माध्यमले रचनात्मक लेखनका लागि के गर्न सक्छ भनेर अन्वेषण गर्नेछौं!
about.jan: जनजालो विश्वको संस्थापक, दर्शनशीलता, र प्रविधिकी बुद्धिसंगी Literary Universe को पछाडि जन छन्। विशालको लेखकीय विश्वबाटसंगै जन प्रायः ताकतशाली साहित्यिक बिश्लेशी लेखन प्रक्रियालाई तकनीकी पुग्गलता र पठनीयतामध्ये समन्वय गर्न गोरखाली, पाठकको अनुभवमा समेट्न छोड्ने कसैलाई टाढा नगरी लेखन कार्यको योजना प्रेरणा दिइन्। यो चुनौतीले उहान संगठनमा अध्ययन गर्नेर वेब विकासमा पठनीयता सम्प्रेषण संजाल निर्माण गर्ने लक्ष्यमा जाने।
about.history.text: 2010 मा, जान नेपालमा वेब विकासको ज्ञानलाई गहिरो गर्न अध्ययन गर्न रोचेस्टर प्रविधि संस्थानमा सुरु गरे। कर्मसूची लेखन प्लेटफर्म निर्माण गर्ने उद्देश्यले। यो विजनले २०१३ मा प्रस्तुती र संविधानमा रूपान्तरण गरियो Imagine RITमा। जानले अध्ययन जारी राख्यो, र २०१६ मा, मास्टर्स क्याप्सटोन प्रकल्पको रूपमा नयाँ संस्करण सृजना गरियो। प्रकल्पले अब्दोशमा सँधै विकास गर्दा, अन्ततः आज तपाइले देख्नुभएको प्लेटफर्ममा परिवर्तन गरेको हो।

homepage.intro: Let Your Creativity Run Wild Across the Literary Universe
homepage.explanation: के तपाईंले कहाँ-कहाँ समेत बिस्तृत गरिएको कल्पनाशील विश्व विकास गर्न ख्वाइरहेका छन्? कथाकारी ब्रह्माण्डमा, हामीले यो दृष्टिबद्धीलाई वास्तविकता बनाउने उपकरणहरू प्रदान गर्दछौं। प्रत्येक कथाकारले शीर्ष-गुणस्तरको स्रोत र समर्थन प्राप्त गर्नका लागि हामीले एक सबैलाई समावेशी स्थान डिजाइन गरेका छौं। कथाकारहरूका लागि, यो सपना कार्यस्थल हो; पाठकहरूका लागि, एक अन्वेषणात्मक यात्रा हो। हामीलाई सहभागी बनाउनुहोस् जब हामी कथाकारी खगोलीय गोतामा जान्छौं, तब हाम्रो अन्तरिक्षको दूरता कति देखाउँछ।
gdpr.title: GDPR अनुपालन
gdpr.explained: The General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) is a data protection law from the European Union that regulates how personal data is collected, processed, stored, and protected. GDPR exists to ensure that every user knows what data is being collected, understands how it is used and has full control over their personal information.
gdpr.compliant: Although LiteraryUniverse operates globally, we apply GDPR principles as a standard of trust and transparency for all users.
dmca.title: डिजिटल मिलेनियम कपिराइट ऐक्ट (DMCA) नीति
dmca.subtitle: कपिराइट विवाद नीति
dmca.summary:
• Use the Report button on the affected work to submit a copyright report or formal DMCA notice.
  • Include the required contact details, signature and statements in a formal notice.
  • If your material was removed by mistake, you can submit a counter-notice in the Resolution Center.
  • The DMCA restoration window follows receipt of a valid counter-notice; it is not a deadline for submitting one.
dmca.explained.title: What is DMCA?
dmca.explained.text:
The Digital Millennium Copyright Act (DMCA) is a copyright protection law that safeguards original digital works such as stories, illustrations, audio, and other creative content published online.
LiteraryUniverse fully respects the rights of creators and applies DMCA procedures to protect both content owners and platform users in a fair and transparent manner.
dmca.reporting.title: Procedure for Reporting Copyright Infringements.
dmca.reporting.text:
1. Internal Property (IP hosted on Literary Universe)

    If the IP exists on our platform, you may submit a report directly using the Report button available on the content, you will then be promted to select which of your work is being infringed upon.

  2. External Property (IP not hosted on Literary Universe)

    If the IP is not hosted on Literary Universe, you may submit a report using the Report button on the creative property that is infringing.

    Do note that this option might take us longer to validate and we might require additional materials to confirm the infringement.
dmca.reporting.requirements:
A formal notice must include:
  • Your physical or electronic signature
  • Identification of the copyrighted work and the material you believe infringes it, with enough information to locate that material
  • Contact details, including your address, telephone number and email where available
  • A statement that you believe the use is not authorized by the rights holder, their representative or the law
  • Confirmation that the notice is accurate and, under penalty of perjury, that you may act for the owner of the exclusive right allegedly infringed
dmca.reporting.warning: Knowingly misrepresenting infringement or misidentification can create legal liability. Repeated abuse may lead to proportionate reporting restrictions after review. A rejected good-faith report alone does not establish abuse.
dmca.ourActions.title: Our Actions
dmca.ourActions.text: We review notices and the identified material. Where the US DMCA process applies, we act expeditiously on valid notices and inform the affected user. We review counter-notices, forward valid ones to the original notifier, and track the restoration window and any notice of court action. Restrictions and restoration depend on the applicable process and other valid grounds for restricting the material. Repeated infringement is assessed from substantiated cases, not report counts alone.
dmca.counterNotice.title: Counter-Notice
dmca.counterNotice.text:
If you believe material was removed or disabled because of a mistake or misidentification, submit a formal counter-notice through the affected work's Resolution Center. Restricted accounts can still sign in to request review.

A counter-notice must contain:

  • Your signature, name, address and telephone number
  • Identification of the removed material and its previous location
  • A statement under penalty of perjury that you believe removal resulted from a mistake or misidentification
  • Consent to the applicable US Federal District Court's jurisdiction and acceptance of service from the notifier or their agent

We review counter-notices and forward valid ones to the original notifier. Where the US DMCA process applies, restoration ordinarily occurs 10 to 14 business days after receipt of a valid counter-notice, unless we receive notice of the specified court action. This is a restoration window, not a 14-day deadline for submitting your counter-notice.
dmca.desc: हामीले कपिराइट उल्लंघनलाई गम्भीरताको साथ लिन्छौं।
gdpr.summary:
• We only collect data necessary to operate the platform or those you want to share.
  • We do not sell your data.
  • You may access, edit, export, or delete your data at any time.
  • We apply industry-standard security to protect your data.
gdpr.desc: The General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and how data is protected at Literary Universe.
gdpr.data.title: What Data we collect
gdpr.data.desc:
Besides the data you put into your profile or generated through your interaction (messages, stories, etc.) we try to collect as little as possible. The data we collect includes:
  • Technical information such as IP address, browser type, and operating system for security and platform functionality
  • Action logs for security and functionality purposes
  • Reading time and reading statistics when you opt in via your settings
  • Writing sessions and writing statistics when you opt in via your settings
  • Diary entries and personal notes you create
  • Bookmarks and reading lists
  • API keys you generate for third-party integrations
  • Author resume data, which may include contact information and an encrypted address, if you choose to create one
Occasionally we might collect data for marketing purposes through third-party services which respect GDPR and you will always have the option to opt out.
gdpr.dataUse.title: How we use Your Data
gdpr.dataUse.desc:
Your data is used for the following purposes:
  • Providing core platform features (e.g., accounts, content publishing, messaging)
  • Security, abuse prevention, and fraud detection
  • Functional analytics to improve performance and user experience
  • Legal compliance and responding to valid requests
  • Reading and writing tracking data is used for your personal statistics and shared in anonymized form with authors so they can understand how readers engage with their work
  • Diary entries and personal notes are private and never shared with anyone
  • We provide your email and country to Stripe for payment processing and fraud protection
  • For marketing purposes, we might use your data, but you will always have the option to opt out (cookie banner, etc.)
gdpr.dataStorage.title: Data storage & security
gdpr.dataStorage.desc:
• All data (except non-sensitive audio visual data) is stored using secure encrypted systems
  • Access is restricted to authorized personnel only utilizing industry standard secure access
  • We regularly perform security audits and updates to ensure the safety of your data
  • All internal communication is over encrypted channels
Despite best efforts, no online system is ever 100% immune. In rare case of a data breach, users will be notified as promptly as possible, as required by law.
gdpr.rights.title: Your rights under GDPR
gdpr.rights.desc:
Under GDPR you have the following rights. You can find options to perform these in your user settings or at the given content:
  • Right to access - Export a comprehensive copy of all data we store about you, covering your account, social connections, personal content, reading and writing data, workshop content, community activity, memberships, author resume, and reports
  • Right to erasure - Delete your account and all private data from our servers. Published works will be anonymized (your name and profile removed) rather than deleted
  • Right to restriction of processing - Control how your data is used via tracking toggles in your settings (e.g., reading time, writing time)
  • Right to data portability - Export your data as a structured JSON file from your account settings
gdpr.dataRetention.title: Data retention
gdpr.dataRetention.desc:
We store your data:
  • As long as your account is active
  • Or as long as required for legal, security, or operational purposes
  • Published creative works are stored indefinitely unless agreed to otherwise. Upon account deletion, published works are anonymized rather than removed
  • Anonymized reading statistics may be retained after account deletion to preserve author analytics
  • Audit logs are retained for compliance purposes with personally identifiable information removed
gdpr.contact.title: Contact
gdpr.contact.desc:
We are only human, so if you have any requests, questions, concerns or we missed something, please don't hesitate to contact us.

Email: privacy@literaryuniverse.com

about.hendry: हेन्ड्री डिजाइनर हुनुहुन्छ जसमा १५ वर्षभन्दा बढी अनुभव छन्। वह २०१० देखि एजेन्सीमा काम गरिरहेका छन्, जस्तै पर्तामिना, भिओए, र पर्यटन मन्त्रालय आदि उनका ग्राहकहरू। ब्राण्डिङ, लेआउट र युआई / यूएक्सको अनुभव पनि भएका उनले साहित्यिक यूनिभर्समा डिजाइन गर्ने चुनौती महसुस गर्दछन्।

copyrights.about: Literary Universe takes Copyright very seriously. All the content that is published by users is their own and available under the license that is specified. Beside the full set of Creative Commons licenses, Literary Universe also offers 2 commercial licenses, exclusive and non-exclusive.
copyrights.nonExclusiveLicense: The Literary Universe Non-Exclusive License allows you to publish on Literary Universe without giving away any of your rights as the copyright holder. You are free to publish anywhere else. Literary Universe only reserves the right to use your IP for marketing purposes. If you decide to sell you IP on Literary Universe the platform will charge 30% platform fee.
copyrights.exclusiveLicense: The Literary Universe Exclusive License allows you to publish on Literary Universe exclusively. That means you can't publish your IP on other online platforms or anything else outside of Literary Universe. If you want to publish a physical medium like a book you need to ask as for permission. If Literary Universe doesn't respond in 30 days then that is automatic consent. In the future we hope to offer you physical publishing and other services via our partners. Don't be afraid to contact us, we wish for your success and in most cases we are just looking out for fraudulent companies. Still this is restrictive, so as a thank you, the platform fee is only 10%.
copyrights.licensesAreImportant: Choosing a license is extremely important and affects how your work will be accessed in the future. To make selection easier you can check out our license chooser bellow.
mission.title: Mission & Vision
mission.desc: Literary Universe's mission: to make authorship a livable craft, so human imagination endures. Read our cause, core values, vision, and company culture.
mission.keieirinen: To make authorship a livable craft, so human imagination endures.
mission.intro: Literary Universe is more than a platform — it is a mission-driven company grounded in values that guide every decision. We strive to build a company that endures for generations, combining innovation with respect for history and tradition. Inspired by Simon Sinek's <link>The Infinite Game</link> and family-run Japanese businesses, we aim to build something lasting and meaningful for authors and readers alike.
mission.cause.title: Our cause
mission.cause.text.1: Most authors earn little to nothing from their work, often undervaluing their creations by giving them away. Literary Universe gives authors the resources to produce, promote, and profit from their work, enabling them to pursue writing as a real career. When our authors succeed, we succeed.
mission.cause.text.2: Stories are vital to society — they inspire and teach across generations. Yet new pressures, including the rapid commodification of creative output by AI, risk dissuading future authors from entering the craft. And as a result even the AI tools will start to suffer from the lack of human generated content to learn from. Literary Universe gives writers the tools, community, and encouragement to flourish, nurturing creativity and literacy from a young age by reaching out to schools and communities.
mission.cause.text.3: We simplify the creative process by integrating everything authors and readers need into a single platform. From creating stories to managing intellectual property to building a fanbase, Literary Universe is the central hub — ensuring authors have full visibility and control over their work and its connections.
mission.values.title: Core values
mission.values.supremacy.title: Supremacy of Human Imagination
mission.values.supremacy.text: We believe human creativity is irreplaceable. AI assists but must never supplants the author's voice. We actively combat low-effort AI slop through labeling, filtering, and prioritization of human-authored works. We will support initiatives for passing down the craft and support authors.
mission.values.paid.title: Get authors paid
mission.values.paid.text: A platform that fails its creators eventually fails its readers. Author income is our primary product metric, not a downstream consequence. Transparent economics, clear ownership terms, and fair revenue shares are non-negotiable.
mission.values.newGen.title: Supporting new generations of writers
mission.values.newGen.text: Education, mentorship, and on-boarding are core to the platform — not optional add-ons. Workshops, writing challenges, and accessible craft resources help new authors flourish.
mission.values.oneStop.title: A one-stop shop
mission.values.oneStop.text: Authors and readers should not have to assemble their creative or reading lives from a half-dozen disconnected services. Literary Universe brings creation, publishing, discovery, community, and monetization into a single connected experience.
mission.values.freedom.title: Creative freedom
mission.values.freedom.text: Creativity thrives on freedom. We support authors' ability to explore complex ideas while adhering to copyright laws and ethical boundaries. We avoid operating in totalitarian countries where free expression cannot be upheld.
mission.values.family.title: Pro-family and pro-humanity
mission.values.family.text: We believe stories help families, communities, and civilizations transmit wisdom, courage, imagination, and memory across generations. We support a company culture that respects family life, long-term health, and meaningful work. Family subscriptions and parental controls are first-class features, not afterthoughts. We reject technology that treats humans as disposable inputs or attention units.
mission.values.meritocracy.title: Freedom and meritocracy
mission.values.meritocracy.text: We reject locking users into our platform or advancing political agendas. We earn loyalty through excellence and integrity, fostering a space where merit and innovation thrive. In an era of declining trust in large platforms — marked by opaque rule changes, exploitative advertising, weakened creator control, and recurring "platform betrayal" cycles — founder mission control serves as a guarantor that the mission stays on track.
mission.values.transparency.title: Transparency
mission.values.transparency.text: Authors deserve full visibility into sales, payouts, and the rules that govern them. Literary Universe promotes trust through clear, accessible data on the platform.
mission.values.ergonomic.title: Ergonomic to human flourishing
mission.values.ergonomic.text: Accelerate human flourishing. We support creativity and human well-being, ensuring the platform uplifts users rather than exploiting them. By highlighting meaningful content, we foster inspiration and deeper connection. We will not build a business model around exploiting reader data or manipulating attention through addictive design. We will invest into in-person events to foster human connection and community.
mission.values.tradition.title: Respect for history and tradition
mission.values.tradition.text: We value the lessons of the past and the stability of tradition. By innovating with technology, we link digital and physical formats, collaborating with traditional publishers for mutual growth.
mission.vision.title: Vision
mission.vision.loyal.title: Fiercely loyal customers
mission.vision.loyal.text: We aim to be more than a product. By fostering community and offering exceptional support, we create a space authors and readers are proud to call home. Local meetups and personalized support for top-tier subscribers strengthen these bonds.
mission.vision.niche.title: Niche dominance
mission.vision.niche.text: Rather than chasing the general market, we focus on excelling in science fiction, fantasy, and adjacent long-form genres — those that benefit most from our worldbuilding tools. Indie SFF is our beachhead. From there, we expand by genre and geography.
mission.vision.beyond.title: Beyond the platform
mission.vision.beyond.text: We see in-person events and meetups as essential for building meaningful connections. Literary Universe, though digital, encourages face-to-face connection to spark creativity and strengthen bonds.
mission.vision.future.title: Future dreams
mission.vision.future.text: We dream of initiatives like StoryCon — an annual writers' conference — and of creating spaces where authors can recharge and create, such as retreats or inspirational offices.
mission.vision.stability.title: Foundational stability
mission.vision.stability.text: Our immediate goal is to build a stable platform, achieve financial sustainability, and foster a healthy work-life balance for our team. This foundation lets us grow responsibly and endure challenges.
mission.culture.title: Company culture
mission.culture.capable.title: Capable individuals and teams
mission.culture.capable.text: We seek highly skilled people who can excel in a dynamic startup environment. Team trust and collaboration are vital, supported by events that build camaraderie and resilience.
mission.culture.oss.title: Open-source philosophy
mission.culture.oss.text: Open source helps us develop efficiently while contributing to the broader community. It fosters innovation, attracts top talent, and aligns with our values of transparency and freedom. We give back and remain active in the communities that support our success.
mission.cultural.title: Cultural impact
mission.cultural.longForm.title: Encouraging long-form content
mission.cultural.longForm.text: In an era of short attention spans, we champion long-form storytelling. As long-form podcasts have shown, audiences value meaningful, immersive, thought-provoking content. Our platform is built around the story world — a unit of imagination that can sustain prose, comics, audio, and lore over years.
mission.cultural.ai.title: Ethical AI integration
mission.cultural.ai.text: AI is here. AI should assist authors, not replace them. Literary Universe uses AI for supportive tasks like editing, research, and translation while ensuring human creativity remains central. AI-generated stories are categorized separately and labelled clearly, protecting the prominence of human authors while still allowing experimentation with new technologies and formats. Creators retain control over whether their work can be used to train external AI systems.
mission.cultural.slop.title: Combating slop culture
mission.cultural.slop.text: We are not anti-AI. We believe some creators will eventually build meaningful AI-generated work with real audiences. But the current market is being flooded with AI slop — low-effort, mass-produced, undifferentiated automated content that overwhelms discovery systems, frustrates readers, and makes it harder for skilled authors to be seen and paid. Literary Universe addresses this with clear labeling of human-authored, AI-assisted, and AI-generated content; discovery systems that prioritize trust and quality signals; anti-spam rules against mass-generated uploads; and human curation for important showcases. The goal is not to ban technology — it is to protect meaningful storytelling.
mission.cultural.politics.title: Resisting political sways
mission.cultural.politics.text: We avoid political or ideological agendas that distract from our mission. Literary Universe focuses on fostering creativity and professionalism while respecting diverse perspectives without endorsing activism. Many of the loudest shouting in the news, moral panics, often prove to be nothing more than just a momentary blib or a footnote in the grand story of humanity. That is why our focus is on art and tradition.

security.title: Security & Responsible Disclosure
security.desc: How to report a security vulnerability in Literary Universe and what to expect from us.
security.summary:
• Report vulnerabilities privately to security@literaryuniverse.com.
  • We acknowledge reports within 3 business days.
  • Good-faith research that follows this policy will not face legal action.
  • No monetary bounty; public credit on request.
security.report.title: How to report
security.report.desc: Email security@literaryuniverse.com with the affected URL or component, the steps to reproduce and the impact you observed, in English or Czech. Machine-readable contact details are published at /.well-known/security.txt (RFC 9116). Please do not open a public issue or post about it before we have responded.
security.scope.title: Scope
security.scope.desc:
• The web application at literaryuniverse.com and its APIs (GraphQL, DDP, /api).
  • The administration and support applications.
  • Our official mobile and browser integrations.
Out of scope: third-party services we integrate (Stripe, sign-in providers), denial-of-service and volumetric attacks, social engineering of staff or users, and findings that require an already compromised device or account.
security.rules.title: Rules of engagement
security.rules.desc:
• Only test with accounts you own; never access, modify or delete other people's data.
  • Stop and report as soon as you can demonstrate the issue — do not exfiltrate data or pivot further.
  • Keep automated scanning well below our rate limits.
  • Do not disclose the issue publicly until we have confirmed a fix or 90 days have passed.
security.response.title: What to expect
security.response.desc: We acknowledge every report within 3 business days, keep you informed while we investigate, and aim to fix confirmed issues within 90 days depending on severity. We do not run a paid bug bounty; with your agreement we credit you on this page once the fix ships.
security.safeHarbor.title: Safe harbour
security.safeHarbor.desc: Research conducted in good faith and in line with this policy is authorised. We will not pursue legal action against you for it, and we will support you if a third party does.
tapas.seo.title: Tapas बाट Literary Universe मा सर्दै
tapas.seo.description: Tapas ३१ मार्च २०२७ मा बन्द हुँदै छ। Tapas माइग्रेटरले सर्जकका शृङ्खला र पाठकका पुस्तकालय Literary Universe मा ल्याउँछ, जसले सकेसम्म Tapas का खरिदहरूलाई मान्यता दिनेछ। आज के गर्ने भन्ने यहाँ छ।
tapas.title: Tapas बाट आउँदै हुनुहुन्छ? स्वागत छ।
tapas.intro: Kakao ले Tapas बन्द गर्दै छ। Ink को बिक्री १ अक्टोबर २०२६ मा रोकियो र साइट ३१ मार्च २०२७ मा प्रशान्त समय (Pacific time) अनुसार २३:५९ बजे बन्द हुनेछ। सर्जक वा पाठक कसैका लागि पनि एक्स्पोर्ट बटन छैन। यसबारे हामी के गर्दै छौँ र तपाईं आज के गर्न सक्नुहुन्छ भन्ने कुरा यो पृष्ठमा छ।
tapas.deadline: Tapas मा कुनै पनि कुरा पढ्ने, अनलक गर्ने वा सुरक्षित गर्ने अन्तिम दिन: ३१ मार्च २०२७, २३:५९ PT।
tapas.creators.title: सर्जकहरूका लागि
tapas.creators.intro: तपाईंको शृङ्खला तपाईंकै हो। Tapas माइग्रेटर तपाईंकै रूपमा Tapas मा साइन इन गर्छ र सबै कुरा ल्याउँछ: पूर्ण रिजोलुसनमा हरेक पृष्ठसहितका कमिक, अध्याय-अध्याय गरी उपन्यास, शीर्षक, क्रम र मूल प्रकाशन मिति, साथै तपाईंका टिप्पणी, ड्यासबोर्डका अङ्क र आम्दानी। यो Apify मा तपाईंकै खातामा चल्छ, र Literary Universe को की (key) भए तयार फाइलहरू सिधै तपाईंको कार्यशालामा पुग्छन्।
tapas.creators.step1: आफ्ना मूल फाइलहरूको ब्याकअप राख्नुहोस्। Tapas ले ती तपाईंलाई पठाउने छैन। तपाईंले अपलोड गरेका फाइलहरू, आवरणहरू र एपिसोडको सूची Tapas बाहेक अन्यत्र कतै राख्नुहोस्।
tapas.creators.step2: यहाँ कार्यशाला खोल्नुहोस्। दर्ता निःशुल्क छ र Creative Commons देखि एक्सक्लुसिभसम्म, तपाईंले जुन इजाजतपत्र रोज्नुहुन्छ त्यसअन्तर्गत तपाईंका अधिकार तपाईंसँगै रहन्छन्।
tapas.creators.step3: माइग्रेटर चलाउनुहोस्। सेटअप गर्न करिब आधा घण्टा लाग्छ र कुनै प्राविधिक ज्ञान चाहिँदैन; गाइडले हरेक फिल्ड बुझाउँछ। उपन्यासकारहरूले DOCX, Markdown, HTML वा टेक्स्ट फाइल सिधै कार्यशालामा पनि राख्न सक्नुहुन्छ।
tapas.creators.step4: कमिक बनाउने सुविधा Storyteller योजनामा पर्छ। कमिक बनाउनुहोस्, यसको ढाँचा र इजाजतपत्र रोज्नुहोस्, र माइग्रेटरको फाइल यसको अध्याय सूचीबाट आयात गर्नुहोस्; हरेक एपिसोड क्रमबद्ध पृष्ठसहित एउटा अध्यायका रूपमा आउँछ। धेरै पृष्ठ एकैपटक राख्न पनि मिल्छ।
tapas.creators.step5: आफ्ना पाठकहरूलाई तपाईं कहाँ जाँदै हुनुहुन्छ भन्नुहोस् र तपाईं आउँदै हुनुहुन्छ भनेर हामीलाई पनि भन्नुहोस्। हामीलाई जति धेरै शृङ्खलाबारे थाहा हुन्छ, तपाईंका पाठकहरूले पहिले नै तिरेको कुरालाई हामी त्यति नै राम्ररी मान्यता दिन सक्छौँ।
tapas.creators.compare: Literary Universe र Tapas को तुलना
tapas.readers.title: पाठकहरूका लागि
tapas.readers.intro: दुई वाचा। पहिलो, बन्द हुँदै गरेको प्लेटफर्मले तपाईंको स्वामित्वको किताब फेरि कहिल्यै आफूसँगै लैजानु हुँदैन। Literary Universe मा तपाईंले किनेका कथाहरू कथा डाउनलोड समावेश भएका योजनाहरूमा EPUB का रूपमा डाउनलोड गर्न सकिन्छ। कमिकहरू अहिलेसम्म डाउनलोड गर्न सकिँदैन, र हामी सकेसम्म धेरै खरिद र पाठकहरूका लागि डाउनलोड खुला गर्ने काम गर्दै छौँ। दोस्रो, यदि कुनै सर्जकले आफ्नो शृङ्खला यहाँ ल्याउनुभयो र तपाईंले Tapas मा के अनलक गर्नुभएको थियो भन्ने भरपर्दो अभिलेख हामीले पाउन सक्यौँ भने, हामी ती खरिदहरूलाई यहाँ मान्यता दिनेछौँ।
tapas.readers.caveat: दोस्रो वाचाका दुई सर्त छन्, जुन हाम्रो नियन्त्रणमा छैनन्: सर्जकले आफ्नो कृति Literary Universe मा प्रकाशित गर्नुपर्छ, र हामीलाई Tapas बाट वा तपाईंबाट प्रमाणित गर्न सकिने खरिद अभिलेख चाहिन्छ। Tapas मा अनलक गरिएका कुरा यहाँ सर्छन् कि सर्दैनन् भन्ने हरेक शृङ्खलाको पृष्ठमा स्पष्ट लेखिनेछ।
tapas.readers.step1: Tapas माइग्रेटरले आफ्नो पुस्तकालय र Ink इतिहास सुरक्षित गर्नुहोस्। यो तपाईंकै रूपमा साइन इन गर्छ र तपाईंको पठन सूची, तपाईंले अनलक गरेका एपिसोड र हरेक Ink कारोबार लेखेर राख्छ; त्यो फाइल जोगाएर राख्नुहोस्, तपाईंले केका लागि तिर्नुभयो भन्ने अभिलेख त्यही हो। <link>गाइडले चरणबद्ध रूपमा कसरी गर्ने देखाउँछ</link>। आफ्नो खाताको डेटाको प्रतिलिपि माग्न तपाईं feedback@tapas.io मा इमेल पनि गर्न सक्नुहुन्छ।
tapas.readers.step2: आफ्ना सर्जकहरूलाई फलो गर्नुहोस्। धेरैजसोले आफू कहाँ जाँदै छन् भन्ने कुरा आफ्ना Tapas शृङ्खलाका पृष्ठ र सामाजिक सञ्जालमा घोषणा गर्दै छन्।
tapas.readers.step3: यहाँ पाठक खाता बनाउनुहोस्, ताकि शृङ्खलाहरू आइपुग्दा तपाईंको पुस्तकालय तयार होस्।
tapas.readers.promo: Try us for six months, free. Pick a plan and enter the promo code {code} at checkout. That is long enough to find out whether this is your new home.
tapas.money.title: Ink, and what we use instead
tapas.money.intro: Tapas sold you Ink, and Ink bought episodes. Literary Universe has no coins. Every price is in real money, and you pay for the thing itself.
tapas.money.payWith.label: What you pay with
tapas.money.payWith.tapas: Ink, bought in packs from $1.99 to $99.99. Episode prices are in Ink, so you do the conversion yourself.
tapas.money.payWith.lu: Money. Creators can set prices in 33 currencies and you check out through Stripe. The price on the page is what you pay.
tapas.money.buy.label: What you can buy
tapas.money.buy.tapas: One episode at a time, with a discount for unlocking many at once.
tapas.money.buy.lu: A single comic chapter or a long prose chapter, a story arc, a whole finished book, or a fan club membership. The creator picks which of these to offer.
tapas.money.leftover.label: What is left over
tapas.money.leftover.tapas: Packs never match what you want to read, so some Ink always stays in the wallet. It cannot be refunded, and it is gone on 31 March 2027.
tapas.money.leftover.lu: Nothing. There is no balance to top up, no pack to round up to and nothing to expire.
tapas.money.free.label: Reading for free
tapas.money.free.tapas: Free episode tickets and Wait Until Free timers.
tapas.money.free.lu: Creators choose how many opening chapters are free, and works under Creative Commons are free all the way through.
tapas.money.creators.label: What the creator gets
tapas.money.creators.tapas: Paid episodes need 5,000 subscribers first, and Tapas does not publish its share of Premium sales.
tapas.money.creators.lu: 90% of each sale under an exclusive license, 70% under a non-exclusive one, before payment processing. No subscriber threshold. Chapters and arcs start at $0.99, books at $1.99.
tapas.guide.step.account: निःशुल्क Apify खाता बनाउनुहोस्। apify.com मा जानुहोस् र आफ्नो इमेल वा Google खाताबाट साइन अप गर्नुहोस्। निःशुल्क योजनासँगै मासिक क्रेडिट आउँछ, र सामान्य आकारको खाताको एक पटकको एक्स्पोर्ट त्यसभित्रै अटाउँछ। तपाईंसँग कार्ड मागिने छैन।
tapas.guide.step.open: माइग्रेटर खोल्नुहोस् र रन सुरु गर्नुहोस्। तलको बटन प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्, त्यसपछि Try for free (निःशुल्क प्रयास गर्नुहोस्) वा Start रोज्नुहोस्। तपाईं एउटा फारममा पुग्नुहुन्छ; यो गाइडको बाँकी भागले त्यसका फिल्डहरू माथिदेखि तलसम्म बुझाउँछ।
tapas.guide.step.mode: के एक्स्पोर्ट गर्ने रोज्नुहोस्। Creator ले तपाईंले प्रकाशन गर्ने शृङ्खलाहरू हरेक एपिसोड, तपाईंका टिप्पणी, ड्यासबोर्डका अङ्क र आम्दानीसहित एक्स्पोर्ट गर्छ। Reader ले तपाईंको पठन सूची, अनलक गरेका एपिसोड र Ink इतिहास एक्स्पोर्ट गर्छ। तपाईं दुवै हुनुहुन्छ भने दुई पटक चलाउनुहोस्।
tapas.guide.step.signin: फारमभित्रै Tapas मा साइन इन गर्नुहोस्। तपाईंले Tapas मा प्रयोग गर्ने इमेल र पासवर्ड Tapas email र Tapas password फिल्डमा टाइप गर्नुहोस्। Apify ले तिनलाई इन्क्रिप्ट गरेर राख्छ र tapas.io मा मात्र पठाउँछ। पाठकले साइन इन गर्नैपर्छ; यो चरण छोड्ने सर्जकले निःशुल्क एपिसोड मात्र पाउँछ र ड्यासबोर्ड पाउँदैन।
tapas.guide.step.key: आफ्नो Literary Universe खाता जोड्नुहोस्। Literary Universe मा सेटिङ्स, त्यसपछि खाता खोल्नुहोस्, र API Keys अन्तर्गत Create New API Key रोज्नुहोस्। यसलाई Tapas migrator नाम दिनुहोस्, story:write मा टिक लगाउनुहोस्, बनाउनुहोस् र की (key) कपी गर्नुहोस्; यो एक पटक मात्र देखाइन्छ। यसलाई फारमको Literary Universe API key फिल्डमा टाँस्नुहोस्। फाइलहरू आफैँ डाउनलोड गरेर आयात गर्न चाहनुहुन्छ भने यो चरण छोड्नुहोस्।
tapas.guide.step.run: Start थिच्नुहोस् र पर्खनुहोस्। उपन्यासलाई केही मिनेट लाग्छ। सयौँ एपिसोड भएको लामो कमिकलाई एक घण्टा वा बढी लाग्न सक्छ, किनभने हरेक पृष्ठको तस्बिर पूर्ण आकारमा डाउनलोड हुन्छ। तपाईं ट्याब बन्द गर्न सक्नुहुन्छ; रन चलिरहन्छ र Log (लग) ट्याबले यसले के गरिरहेको छ देखाउँछ। सकिएपछि यो हरियो हुन्छ।
tapas.guide.step.novel: उपन्यास आयात गर्नुहोस्। आफ्नो कार्यशाला खोल्नुहोस्, Import रोज्नुहोस्, र Tapas बाट प्राप्त अन्तर्गत आफ्नो शृङ्खला खोज्नुहोस्। यो फाइल आयात गर्नुहोस् थिच्नुहोस्, पूर्वावलोकनमा अध्यायहरू ठीक देखिन्छन् कि जाँच्नुहोस्, कथालाई भाषा, रेटिङ र इजाजतपत्र दिनुहोस्, र आयात गर्नुहोस्। Tapas को हरेक एपिसोड आफ्नै शीर्षकसहित एउटा अध्याय बन्छ।
tapas.guide.step.comic: कमिक आयात गर्नुहोस्। कार्यशालामा पहिले कमिक बनाउनुहोस् र यसको ढाँचा (वेबटुन, मङ्गा वा पृष्ठगत) र इजाजतपत्र रोज्नुहोस्; कमिक Storyteller योजनामा पर्छ। त्यसपछि यसको अध्याय सूची खोल्नुहोस्, Tapas बाट प्राप्त अन्तर्गत शृङ्खला खोज्नुहोस् र यो फाइल आयात गर्नुहोस् थिच्नुहोस्। हरेक एपिसोड क्रमबद्ध पृष्ठसहित एउटा अध्याय बन्छ। Tapas ले लक राखेका एपिसोड छुट्छन्; ती पृष्ठ आफ्नै फाइलबाट अपलोड गर्नुहोस्।
tapas.guide.step.reader: पाठकहरू: आफ्नो अभिलेख राख्नुहोस्। रनले Apify को Storage (भण्डारण) अन्तर्गत तपाईंको पठन सूची र Ink कारोबारहरू पढ्न मिल्ने फाइलका रूपमा भएको zip छोड्छ। यसलाई डाउनलोड गरेर राख्नुहोस्; कुनै सर्जकले शृङ्खला यहाँ ल्याउनुभयो र तपाईं आफ्ना Tapas अनलकहरूलाई मान्यता दिलाउन चाहनुहुन्छ भने त्यो फाइल नै तपाईंको प्रमाण हो। कुनै शृङ्खलाबारे सोध्दा हामीलाई सारांश पठाउनुहोस्।
tapas.guide.faq.captcha.q: रन रोकियो र Tapas ले reCAPTCHA माग्यो भन्छ। अब के गर्ने?
tapas.guide.faq.captcha.a: साइन इन सर्भरबाट आउँदा Tapas ले कहिलेकाहीँ मानिस हो कि भनेर जाँच गर्न खोज्छ। यसबाट उम्कने दुई उपाय छन्। सबैभन्दा सजिलो माइग्रेटरलाई आफ्नो ब्राउजर सेसन दिनु हो: Tapas मा साइन इन भएको ब्राउजरमा F12 थिचेर डेभलपर टुल खोल्नुहोस्, Network (नेटवर्क) ट्याब रोज्नुहोस्, पृष्ठ रिलोड गर्नुहोस्, tapas.io लेखिएको पहिलो पङ्क्तिमा क्लिक गर्नुहोस्, यसको Request headers (अनुरोध हेडर) मा cookie भन्ने लाइनसम्म स्क्रोल गर्नुहोस्, त्यसपछिको सबै कपी गरेर Tapas cookies फिल्डमा टाँस्नुहोस्। अर्को उपाय 2captcha.com मा खाता खोल्नु हो, जसको की (key) तपाईं 2Captcha API key फिल्डमा टाँस्नुहुन्छ; यसले करिब एक सेन्टको एक तिहाइमा जाँच हल गर्छ।
tapas.guide.faq.missing.a: Ink वा Early Access पछाडिका एपिसोड तिनको स्वामित्व भएको खातालाई मात्र दिइन्छ, र पूरै डाउनलोड नभएको एपिसोडका तस्बिरहरू छोडिन्छन्, ताकि कुनै अध्याय कहिल्यै आधा मात्र नआओस्। रनले तिनलाई locked.json मा सूचीबद्ध गर्छ। सर्जकका रूपमा साइन इन गर्नुहोस्, वा ती पृष्ठ आफ्नै फाइलबाट अपलोड गर्नुहोस्।
tapas.guide.faq.gone.q: Literary Universe ले फाइल अब उपलब्ध छैन भन्छ।
tapas.guide.faq.gone.a: Literary Universe ले फाइलहरूको लिङ्क मात्र राख्छ, फाइलहरू तपाईंको Apify खातामा हुन्छन्। निःशुल्क योजनामा Apify ले रनका फाइलहरू सात दिनपछि मेटाउँछ। एक हप्ताभित्र आयात गर्नुहोस्, वा माइग्रेटर फेरि चलाउनुहोस्; तस्बिर र टिप्पणी छोड्नुभयो भने दोस्रो पटक छिटो हुन्छ।
tapas.guide.faq.safe.q: यसलाई मेरा पासवर्ड दिनु सुरक्षित छ?
tapas.guide.faq.safe.a: माइग्रेटर तपाईंकै Apify खातामा चल्छ; Literary Universe मा कसैले पनि रन, फाइल वा पासवर्ड देख्दैन। Apify ले पासवर्ड फिल्डहरू इन्क्रिप्ट गर्छ, र Tapas पासवर्ड साइन इन गर्न एक पटक मात्र प्रयोग हुन्छ। Literary Universe को की (key) ले आयात फाइल दर्ता गर्न मात्र सक्छ; पछि तपाईं यसलाई सेटिङ्स, खाता, API Keys अन्तर्गत रद्द गर्न सक्नुहुन्छ। कोड प्रकाशित छ, त्यसैले यसले के गर्छ भनेर जो कोहीले पढ्न सक्छ।
tapas.guide.faq.cost.a: माइग्रेटर निःशुल्क छ। Apify ले कम्प्युटर समयको शुल्क लिन्छ: टेक्स्ट मात्रको एक्स्पोर्टलाई केही सेन्ट लाग्छ, र सबै तस्बिरसहितको लामो कमिक प्रायः एक डलरभन्दा कममा, निःशुल्क योजनाको मासिक क्रेडिटभित्रै सकिन्छ। Literary Universe ले आयातका लागि केही लिँदैन।
tapas.guide.seo.title: आफ्नो Tapas शृङ्खला र पुस्तकालय Literary Universe मा कसरी सार्ने
tapas.guide.seo.description: Tapas माइग्रेटरको चरणबद्ध गाइड: Tapas बन्द हुनुअघि आफ्ना कमिक, उपन्यास, पुस्तकालय र Ink इतिहास एक्स्पोर्ट गर्नुहोस् र Literary Universe मा ल्याउनुहोस्। कुनै प्राविधिक ज्ञान चाहिँदैन।
tapas.guide.title: Tapas बाट सर्ने, चरणबद्ध रूपमा
tapas.guide.intro: Tapas माइग्रेटर Apify मा चल्ने एउटा सानो प्रोग्राम हो; Apify यस्ता प्रोग्रामहरू क्लाउडमा चलाउने सेवा हो, त्यसैले केही पनि इन्स्टल गर्नुपर्दैन। यो तपाईंकै रूपमा Tapas मा साइन इन गर्छ, तपाईंका शृङ्खला वा पुस्तकालय जम्मा गर्छ, र तयार फाइलहरू Literary Universe लाई दिन्छ। सेटअपका लागि आधा घण्टा छुट्याउनुहोस्, त्यसपछि यसलाई काम गर्न दिनुहोस्।
tapas.guide.needs: तपाईंलाई तीन कुरा चाहिन्छ: तपाईंको Tapas इमेल र पासवर्ड, Literary Universe खाता, र निःशुल्क Apify खाता, जुन चरण १ मा बुझाइएको छ।
tapas.guide.faq.title: केही योजनाअनुसार नभएमा
